static_traits.name: Chen Fei
static_traits.social_status: Having several close friends, but not yet sharing feelings for fear they will not understand my passion for film; recently tense relationships with friends due to frequent negative talk
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problem history; never received psychotherapy or counseling; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, high cooperativeness, neutral tone; able to concretely describe automatic thoughts and triggering situations; tending to use dismissal and comparison, focusing on failure experiences

basic_info.main_problem: After not winning an award in a recent film competition, I feel that making films is meaningless, which has led to Self-doubt and insufficient motivation.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to stop feeling like a failure and regain my motivation for filmmaking.

core_beliefs: If I am not recognized (winning awards / being liked by others), my efforts are meaningless

special_situations.event: Not winning an award in the film competition (results announced about a month ago)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I did not win an award in the competition, it proves I am not good enough, and continuing to film is meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Considering giving up film creation, trying to shift attention to other hobbies to escape the sense of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This failure shows I am not good enough, and filming is meaningless

special_situations.event: Watching other filmmakers' works or seeing their success
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are more successful than me, it shows no one will care about my work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids starting new projects or reduces creative investment to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am inferior to them; no one will care about my work

special_situations.event: When trying to start writing a new script, sits down to prepare to create
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot ensure the audience will like it, it is not worth starting
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Puts the script away and stops writing to avoid disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one will want to watch my work; I will never be good enough

special_situations.event: Recalls this competition failure and ignores the positive feedback received in the past
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure confirms all my doubts; past praise does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly immersing in negative outcomes, dismissing positive experiences to maintain the existing conclusion
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This failure proves I cannot do it

core_conflict.wish: Longs for the work to be recognized, seen, and understood
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being dismissed, worrying that no one understands my passion
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being evaluated and dismissed by avoiding creation and not sharing with friends
Using the competition failure as justification for giving up and withdrawing, as self-protection

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, an overlooked creator
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judges who do not understand me (audience / peers / friends)

object_relations.self_representation: Friends who habitually speak from a negative perspective
object_relations.object_representation: Bystanders who do not understand my passion

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out past positive feedback or invites identifying more evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing this failure is decisive evidence, and past praise does not represent true ability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a calm but firm tone, repeats the reasons for failure, describes giving up as the logical choice, and downplays the relevance of past successes.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether one shares feelings with friends and seeks support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing friends will not understand or will look down on my passion, so sharing is meaningless and would make things worse
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a cautious, avoidant tone, emphasizing 'they will not understand', avoiding in-depth discussion of specific relationship details.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When proposed to do small-step behavioral experiments or try new projects
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing the experiment as a risk that might again confirm I am not good enough, feeling afraid
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First acknowledges the fear, gentle in tone, proposes breaking the task into manageable micro-goals, and requests gradual progress.

manifestations: Feeling that continuing to film is meaningless after not winning the competition
Worrying friends will not understand my passion and thus unwilling to share feelings
outcomes: Reduced social support and increased sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing friends will not understand my passion for film and proactively not sharing
Presupposing others' reactions as negative, leading to relationship estrangement

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats winning the competition as the only measure of worth
The self-demand 'I should stop trying' appears

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Trying to distract with other hobbies to avoid facing failure and Self-doubt

positive_force: Has a strong passion for photography (describes herself as 'obsessed with photographing')
Willing to try new methods and accept small-step experiments
Has had the experience of receiving positive feedback on work
negative_force: Black-and-white thinking; failure means total dismissal
Mental filtering and dismissing positive evidence, over-focusing on not winning an award
Compares excessively with others, seeking external validation
Intense Self-doubt and the belief of 'meaningless'
Avoids creating and social disclosure, reducing support-seeking

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance and Self-denial when starting creation (stopping screenwriting / abandoning projects)
antecedent: Thinking about filming or preparing to launch a new project
Recalling the result of not winning the competition
Watches other filmmakers' works and success cases
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing one failure and internalizing it as a self-worth judgment, over-relying on external recognition, worrying the work will not be liked by the audience
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the pain of failure and being evaluated, lowering anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, considering giving up a film career; tense relationships with friends; lowered daily motivation and productivity
